//: The account types the Marketplace's Connections view lists (docs/SYNERGY-CONNECTORS.md 2.1, phase C0): the templates Phoenix has today, all built in. Catalog::publish() checks each one and writes it into the signed index as `accounts`; iconFrom (a file in this repository, not published) is copied to `icon` under the published folder. capabilities use each template's own capabilityProviders[].capability. signUp: where a person without an account gets one (https), when there is a public page for it: the Fediverse's list of servers; none for the types whose server is the user's own (CardDAV, mail) or that need no account (a subscribed calendar). Phoenix's own connector packages in the catalog that it does not come with (Jabber, Matrix, Delta Chat: phoenix-connectors.json, which bin/serve.sh uploads as Phoenix's) list their types from their packages (catalog.json), as a developer's do.

accounts.title: CardDAV & CalDAV
accounts.summary: Your contacts and calendars from Nextcloud, Radicale or any other CardDAV and CalDAV server, kept in step both ways.

accounts.title: Fediverse
accounts.provider: Mastodon, GoToSocial, Akkoma, Pixelfed and other servers
accounts.summary: The people you follow on your contact cards, direct mentions in Messaging, mentions, follows and boosts as notifications, and Share to post a link or a photo.

privacy.dataGoesTo: the server of your handle (and, for direct mentions, the servers of the people you write to)

accounts.title: Subscribed Calendar
accounts.summary: A public calendar (holidays, a team's fixtures, a school's terms) in Calendar, read only and refreshed now and then.

privacy.dataGoesTo: nowhere: Phoenix only reads the calendar address you enter

accounts.title: Email Account
accounts.provider: Any IMAP or POP mail server
accounts.summary: Mail from your own provider in Email, over IMAP or POP, sent over SMTP: webOS's own mail transports.
